gloss: to hit, to knock, to beat

definitions.gloss: to hit, to strike, to beat
definitions.explanation: To hit repeatedly or with force.
To strike lightly to make a sound.

notes:
{叩|たた}く means to hit, knock, or beat. A transitive godan verb with both physical and figurative uses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ドアを{叩|たた}く: to knock on a door
- {太鼓|たいこ}を{叩|たた}く: to beat a drum
- {肩|かた}を{叩|たた}く: to pat on the shoulder
- {手|て}を{叩|たた}く: to clap hands
- キーボードを{叩|たた}く: to type (lit. hit the keyboard)

FIGURATIVE USE:
{叩|たた}く can mean "to criticize harshly":
- マスコミに{叩|たた}かれる: to be attacked by media
- ネットで{叩|たた}かれる: to be criticized online

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. No common intransitive pair.
